# Documentation

> Documentation files for Large Language Models

## Documentation

- [Writing](https://zudoku.dev/docs/writing.md): A guide to writing documentation in Zudoku using Markdown and MDX.
- [Quickstart](https://zudoku.dev/docs/quickstart.md): Get started with Zudoku by creating a new Zudoku app using the `create-zudoku` tool.
- [Zudoku Plugins](https://zudoku.dev/docs/plugins.md)
- [Deploying Zudoku](https://zudoku.dev/docs/deployment.md)
- [Custom Plugins](https://zudoku.dev/docs/custom-plugins.md)
- [x-zudoku-playground-enabled](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-zudoku-playground-enabled.md)
- [x-zudoku-collapsible](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-zudoku-collapsible.md)
- [x-zudoku-collapsed](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-zudoku-collapsed.md)
- [x-tagGroups](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-tag-groups.md)
- [x-mcp](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-mcp.md)
- [x-mcp-server](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-mcp-server.md)
- [x-displayName](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-display-name.md)
- [x-code-samples](https://zudoku.dev/docs/openapi-extensions/x-code-samples.md)
- [Markdown](https://zudoku.dev/docs/markdown/overview.md): Comprehensive guide to using Markdown and MDX in Zudoku, including formatting, frontmatter, syntax highlighting, tables, lists, task lists, collapsible sections, and advanced documentation features.
- [MDX](https://zudoku.dev/docs/markdown/mdx.md): Learn how to use MDX in Zudoku to create rich documentation pages with markdown and custom React components.
- [Frontmatter](https://zudoku.dev/docs/markdown/frontmatter.md): Learn how to use YAML frontmatter in Zudoku markdown files to customize page titles, descriptions, navigation, and other document properties.
- [Code Blocks](https://zudoku.dev/docs/markdown/code-blocks.md): Learn how to use code blocks, syntax highlighting, and advanced features like line highlighting and ANSI output in Zudoku Markdown with Shiki.
- [Admonitions](https://zudoku.dev/docs/markdown/admonitions.md): Learn how to use admonitions (callouts) in Markdown, including syntax, types, titles, and formatting tips for compatibility with Prettier.
- [Multiple APIs](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/using-multiple-apis.md)
- [Transforming Operation Examples](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/transforming-examples.md)
- [Static Files](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/static-files.md): Learn how to serve and reference static files like images and PDFs in your Zudoku documentation using the public directory.
- [Server-side Content Protection](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/server-side-content-protection.md): How Zudoku isolates protected-route content at build time in SSR mode. Covers the auto-detection rules, caveats for dynamic routes and inline content, and a pre-ship checklist.
- [Redirects](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/redirects.md): Configure URL redirects in your Zudoku developer portal to set landing pages, maintain backward compatibility, and handle URL changes. Covers redirect behavior, basePath interaction, and troubleshooting.
- [/docs/guides/processors](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/processors.md)
- [Navigation Rules](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/navigation-rules.md)
- [Navigation Migration](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/navigation-migration.md)
- [Mermaid Diagrams](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/mermaid.md)
- [Documenting MCP Servers](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/mcp-servers.md)
- [Managing API Keys and Identities](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/managing-api-keys-and-identities.md)
- [Environment Variables](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/environment-variables.md)
- [Custom pages](https://zudoku.dev/docs/guides/custom-pages.md)
- [Hooks](https://zudoku.dev/docs/extending/hooks.md): Reference for the React hooks exported by Zudoku.
- [Events](https://zudoku.dev/docs/extending/events.md)
- [Zuplo](https://zudoku.dev/docs/deploy/zuplo.md)
- [Vercel](https://zudoku.dev/docs/deploy/vercel.md)
- [GitHub Pages](https://zudoku.dev/docs/deploy/github-pages.md)

- [Cloudflare Pages](https://zudoku.dev/docs/deploy/cloudflare-pages.md)
- [Apache & Nginx](https://zudoku.dev/docs/deploy/apache-nginx.md)
- [Font & Typography](https://zudoku.dev/docs/customization/fonts.md): Learn how to customize fonts and typography in Zudoku using predefined Google Fonts, custom font URLs, or local fonts for sans, serif, and monospace text.
- [Colors & Theme](https://zudoku.dev/docs/customization/colors-theme.md): Customize your Zudoku site's colors and theme with flexible options, including light/dark modes, custom CSS, and shadcn registry integration.
- [Vite Config](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/vite-config.md)
- [Slots](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/slots.md): Learn how to use slots to inject custom content into predefined locations throughout your Zudoku site.
- [/docs/configuration/site](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/site.md): Customize your Zudoku site's branding, logo, banner, and layout options with detailed configuration examples and guidance.
- [/docs/configuration/sentry](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/sentry.md)
- [Search](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/search.md): Learn how to configure and customize search functionality in Zudoku, including setup instructions for Pagefind and Inkeep providers, result transformation, and ranking options.
- [Protected Routes](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/protected-routes.md): Learn how to protect specific routes in your documentation using authentication, including simple array patterns, advanced authorization with reason codes, and custom callback functions.
- [Configuration File](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/overview.md): Learn how to configure your Zudoku documentation site using the configuration file. Covers file formats, options, examples, and best practices.
- [OAuth Security Schemes](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/oauth-security-schemes.md)
- [Navigation](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/navigation.md): Learn how to configure the navigation in Zudoku, including links, categories, documents, and custom pages. Understand the structure of the navigation array and how to use icons, labels, and paths.
- [LLM-Friendly Documentation Export](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/llms.md)
- [/docs/configuration/footer](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/footer.md): Learn how to configure the footer in Zudoku, including columns, social links, copyright notice, and logo. Customize the footer's position and content with slots.
- [Documentation](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/docs.md)
- [/docs/configuration/build-configuration](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/build-configuration.md)
- [Overview](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication.md)
- [Supabase Setup](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-supabase.md): Learn how to set up Supabase authentication for Zudoku using email and password or OAuth providers for secure documentation access.
- [PingFederate Setup](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-pingfederate.md): Learn how to set up PingFederate authentication for Zudoku using OpenID Connect for enterprise-grade single sign-on.
- [OpenID Connect (OIDC)](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-openid.md): Configure any OpenID Connect compliant identity provider (Okta, Keycloak, Authentik, etc.) as the authentication provider for Zudoku.
- [Firebase Setup](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-firebase.md): Learn how to set up Firebase Authentication for Zudoku, leveraging Google's secure authentication infrastructure with multiple sign-in providers.
- [Clerk Setup](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-clerk.md): Learn how to set up Clerk authentication for Zudoku, providing a seamless authentication experience with modern UI components and extensive customization options.
- [Azure AD Setup](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-azure-ad.md): Learn how to set up Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) authentication for Zudoku, enabling secure single sign-on for your organization.
- [Auth0 Setup](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/authentication-auth0.md): Learn how to set up Auth0 authentication for Zudoku, including application configuration and integration steps for secure API documentation access.
- [API Reference](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/api-reference.md): Learn how to configure the `apis` setting in Zudoku to generate API reference documentation from OpenAPI files, including file and URL references, versioning, customization options, and OpenAPI extensions.
- [API Catalog](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/api-catalog.md)
- [AI Assistants](https://zudoku.dev/docs/configuration/ai-assistants.md): Configure which AI assistant integrations appear in dropdown menus across your Zudoku documentation site, including built-in presets and custom providers.
